items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: And a piano player I know, Nini Waters.

ctx.x: No, another one that never became popular. He stayed around Pittsburgh. And then there was a very popular drummer around Pittsburgh by the name of 'Honey Boy'. And a piano player I know, Nini Waters. Of course now, I remember by this time I was becoming familiar with some of the local musicians and I think Billy Eckstine was working with one of the local big bands in Pittsburgh before he got his own band, and before he went with Earl Hines. But I don't remember
